source.stem:
The area of the region

\[
\left\{(x, y): 0 \leq x \leq \frac{9}{4}, \quad 0 \leq y \leq 1, \quad x \geq 3 y, \quad x+y \geq 2\right\}
\]

is

(A) $\frac{11}{32}$

(B) $\frac{35}{96}$

(C) $\frac{37}{96}$

(D) $\frac{13}{32}$

intelligence.enrichment: Figures made from the same number of unit squares have the same area, but their perimeters can differ; attaching a new square changes perimeter according to how many outside edges are added and how many existing outside edges become shared inside edges.
